name: CTID ATT&CK → AWS Security Services Mapping
owner: Center for Threat-Informed Defense (CTID) — MITRE Engenuity
description: Mapping of MITRE ATT&CK 9.0 Enterprise techniques to AWS security service capabilities. Identifies which AWS services counter which ATT&CK techniques. Snapshot date 2021-09-21.
relationToCloudSecurity: Canonical reference for AWS-platform threat-informed defense gap analysis. Used by AWS-using security teams to map detections to ATT&CK.

license.notes: Apache-2.0 from the CTID mappings-explorer repo.

lifecycle.notes: Snapshot. Re-pull from upstream for refresh.

current_extraction.notes: Reference-only. Upstream publishes this mapping at mappings/aws/attack-9.0/ and retains prior versions (attack-9.0, attack-16.1). Fetch from upstream rather than relying on a copy here.

extraction_history.reason: Removed the committed mapping and reverted to reference-only, matching this document's already-declared desired_end_state. The snapshot mapped ATT&CK 9.0 against a current 19.2, and upstream retains every version we held (attack-9.0, attack-16.1) plus newer ones. Files remain in git history and S3.

notes: Pinned to ATT&CK 9.0; re-pull for newer ATT&CK versions.

desired_end_state.notes: CTID mappings are Apache-2.0 and published upstream with prior versions retained (attack-9.0, attack-16.1), so a copy here drifts without adding anything. Stub points upstream.
